A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure raise the share of lung cancer patients who get curative-intent treatment, and by how much?
Measure: Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated. Every stage I patient who is too frail for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy (3-8 visits, no anaesthesia) instead of being left without treatment. The treatment exists in every university hospital; what is missing in some counties is the referral rule.
supported_en: A Dutch national registry study (Annals of Oncology, 2012) found a 7% absolute fall in untreated elderly stage I patients after precision radiotherapy became available.
not_supported_en: Neither the 0.8-point gain across all lung cancer patients nor the 8% share of elderly stage I patients is shown, and nothing shows that a referral rule adds anything once KYS already offers the treatment.
in_use_quote: Jos kyseessä on pieni keuhkotuumori eikä kasvain ole paikallisesti edennyt, voidaan antaa täsmäsädehoitoa mikäli potilaan yleistila tai muut sairaudet eivät salli operatiivista hoitoa.
missing_en: No page shows a rule that every frail stage I patient is referred for precision radiotherapy, or any figures on how often this happens.
summary_en: The KYS lung cancer care pathway (version from 2021) says that a small lung tumour that has not spread locally may be treated with precision radiotherapy when the patient's general health or other illnesses rule out surgery. It also says every lung cancer patient is discussed at least once in a meeting where the treatment decision is made. No page says that every eligible patient must be referred, and no South Savo (Eloisa) page on this was found. The Dutch national cancer registry study (Annals of Oncology, 2012) found 7% fewer untreated elderly stage I patients once this radiotherapy was fully available.
unanswered_en: I found no South Savo (Eloisa) page or KYS figures showing whether all frail stage I patients are actually referred.
